english_prefix: Sections 39.82–39.88 are adopted through the public entry UC.RegisterDecisionRepresentation.
text: 第 39.75—39.81 节的原实际源、有限期限最优性和参数边界分别对应 UC.RegisterJointDecisionSource、UC.RegisterJointDecisionOptimality 与 UC.RegisterJointDecisionBoundary。来源、返回动作表、全部允许历史实随机比较类、实际单钱包预付、完整有理重放和独立审查见[联合决策交付包](../formalization/ueot-core/docs/compression/theory_completion/unified_closure/joint_decision_closure_v1/README.md)。该合同保留同一持久参数、明确动作与收据权限、零收入有限钱包及预先固定的终端评价；它不把有限 Bayes 最优性替换为无限时域或机制未知时的 minimax 结论。
text_en: For Sections 39.75–39.81, the original actual source, finite-horizon optimality, and parameter boundaries correspond, respectively, to UC.RegisterJointDecisionSource, UC.RegisterJointDecisionOptimality, and UC.RegisterJointDecisionBoundary. The source, returned action table, complete comparison class of real-randomized strategies on permitted histories, actual single-wallet prepayment, complete rational replay, and independent review are recorded in the [joint decision delivery package](../formalization/ueot-core/docs/compression/theory_completion/unified_closure/joint_decision_closure_v1/README.md). This contract retains the same persistent parameter, explicit action and receipt permissions, a finite zero-income wallet, and a terminal evaluation fixed in advance. Finite-horizon Bayes optimality is not replaced by an infinite-horizon or unknown-mechanism minimax conclusion.
